title: A circuit
info: Think of a loop: battery, wire, bulb, wire, back to the battery.
Every part must touch in a complete loop or the electricity cannot travel around.

questions.q: Which set can light a bulb?
options: a bulb alone on the table
battery, wires, and a bulb in a closed loop
stops inside the glass and stays
leaves the battery, goes through the bulb, and returns

questions.q: Adding a closed switch to a working loop
options: opens a hole in the bulb
